annotations.title: The person most likely to own the decision, with why, route type and confidence

description: For one opportunity (opportunity_id from search_opportunities) or one organization (dfx_id): the recommended person and up to two backups, each with title, role family, why this person fits THIS opportunity, decision authority (observed from a source, or inferred from the title, and labelled which), the contact route TYPES on record with their rights class (RESALEABLE, REVEALABLE, INTERNAL_USE) and verification, role freshness, the kind of source that shows the person, and confidence by dimension (identity, current role, role relevance, email, phone, authority, overall). Also the opportunity's readiness rung (SIGNAL_ONLY to COMMERCIAL_READY) and what blocks the next rung. With a purpose and a dfx_id, people are re-ranked for that purpose (recruiting, lp_fundraising, credit_origination ...). Never returns an email address or phone number: routes are types only, and a person known only from a provider is returned as a role, not a name. If nobody suitable is on record it says so; a generic inbox is never offered as a substitute.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id (dfx:<graph>:<uuid>) or a bare real estate UUID.

purpose.description: What the caller wants to talk about; re-ranks people at an organization.
